request.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o WHERE HAS_RELATED(o.customer, KEY(:part, :id))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer c WHERE HAS_RELATED(c.orders, KEY(:part, :id, :third))
SELECT o.part, o.id, o.third, RELATED_KEYS(o.customer, 2) AS customers FROM Orders o ORDER BY o.part, o.id, o.third LIMIT 10
SELECT c.part, c.id, RELATED_KEYS(c.orders, 2) AS orders FROM Customer c ORDER BY c.part, c.id LIMIT 10
SELECT o.part, o.id, o.third, RELATED_KEYS(o.customer, 2) AS customers FROM Orders o WHERE (o.part, o.id, o.third) > (:part, :id, :third) ORDER BY o.part, o.id, o.third LIMIT 10
SELECT c.part, c.id, RELATED_KEYS(c.orders, 2) AS orders FROM Customer c WHERE (c.part, c.id) > (:part, :id) ORDER BY c.part, c.id LIMIT 10
